definition: A plan diagram drawn for neither this style nor any style it answers to. The composer may still build a candidate on it, but only as a borrowing, and every candidate built on it says so.
basis: Our wording of the composer's nativity relation. build/compose.py, nativity: "Borrowed means neither: the composer is using a diagram that nothing in this style's own line was drawn with, and every candidate built on it says so."; build/compose.py, pick_partis: "NOT native to this style — the composer is borrowing a diagram".
